_comment: Silero v5.1.2 published whisper.cpp .bin, stored F16/F32 expanded to F32.

Reference: original upstream tag v5.1.2 JIT SHA256 85c48e1f0ecb604e5d2a268f3ccfb912d4f7e935acdc86af5a3fc5b0aea7b29a, with all 15 binary payloads loaded into its state_dict. Every payload exactly equals upstream rounded to its stored type.
Regime: torch 2.8.0 CPU one thread; native CPU 1/4 threads, macOS arm64 Apple M4; all nine cases from silero-vad-v6.2.manifest.json. Run scripts/vad/bin_parity.py --bin ggml-silero-v5.1.2.bin.

All bounds inherit the existing silero_vad.json budget EXCEPT dec.lstm_c max_abs. No probability tolerance is widened. Observed worst probability max_abs 3.040e-6, worst mean_abs 1.772e-7; exact offline segments and live events.

V5 cell-state scale is materially larger than v6: love-loss reaches |c|=1346.6324 (p99 |c|=208.1304), vs bounded hidden state tanh(c). Worst cell error 0.0067138671875 at frame4946/unit68: native -1118.8033, reference -1118.7966; relative 6.001e-6.

Mechanism: near-unity forget gates preserve fp32 recurrence/reduction rounding over thousands of steps. At that frame/unit f=0.9999797956, i=0.0024985668, g=-0.9889310370, o=0.1112969791 (FP64 replay). tanh(c) saturates, so this large absolute cell-state error does not propagate into hidden states/probabilities.

Independent FP64 Torch recurrence using the reference encoder and same expanded weights gives c=-1118.801142698 at that index: native error 0.00220203, reference error 0.00451184. Across the clip native vs FP64 max=0.00306821, reference vs FP64 max=0.00576443, confirming fp32 accumulation rather than graph/padding mismatch.

Per contribution policy, widened dec.lstm_c max_abs = 1.5 * observed = 0.01007080078125 (rounded up to 0.010071). Its mean_abs remains unchanged at 3.553e-5; observed worst mean=1.928e-5. Every other tensor remains within the original v6 budgets.
